Rashi on Ketubot 71b:10:1.english: That he locks [the door] in front of her - In the Gemara, [it] explains [this].

Rashi on Ketubot 71b:10:2.english: Due to something else - In the Gemara, [this] is explained.

Rashi on Ketubot 71b:11:1.english: That you tell so-and-so - In the Gemara it explains [this].

Rashi on Ketubot 71b:11:2.english: That she fill and pour - [This] is explained in the Gemara.

Rashi on Ketubot 71b:12:1.hebrew: סיפא - דקתני שלשה יוציא, הא שנים יקיים — אתאן לכהנת:
Rashi on Ketubot 71b:12:1.english: The latter clause - Which teaches [that for] three [Festivals] he must divorce [her, implying] that [for] two he may maintain [her] — we have come to [the case of] a kohen's wife.

Rashi on Ketubot 71b:13:1.hebrew: רדופה - לילך לבית אביה תמיד. שנים יוציא; שאינה רדופה, שנים יקיים:
Rashi on Ketubot 71b:13:1.english: Eager - to go to her father's house constantly. [If the vow is for] two [Festivals], he must divorce [her]; [for one] who is not eager, [for] two [Festivals] he may keep [her].

Rashi on Ketubot 71b:14:1.english: [The word] "as it is written" - We do not read [it in the text].

Rashi on Ketubot 71b:15:1.english: My husband [Ishi] - An expression of marital union and marriage.

Rashi on Ketubot 71b:15:2.english: Like a bride in her father-in-law’s house - Who has already been married and feels at ease with her husband, and is not bashful before him.

Rashi on Ketubot 71b:1:1.english: With colored garments - It is a disgrace and humiliation for her, and she becomes repulsive to him.

Rashi on Ketubot 71b:1:2.hebrew: הכא במאי עסקינן - קישוט דמתני' דהכא:
Rashi on Ketubot 71b:1:2.english: Here we are dealing with - [This refers to] the adornment of our Mishnah here.

Rashi on Ketubot 71b:1:3.english: With regard to matters that are between him and her - [Such as] a substance that causes hair to fall out.

Rashi on Ketubot 71b:2:1.hebrew: בעפר פיר - בעפר חור שהוא גדל שם; כלומר, בדבר שהוא רגיל בו, בקי הוא להשמר שאינו מזיקו:
Rashi on Ketubot 71b:2:1.english: In the dirt of a pit - In the dirt of a hole where it grows up; that is to say, regarding something to which one is accustomed, he is adept at guarding himself so that it does not harm him.

Rashi on Ketubot 71b:2:2.hebrew: פיר - כמו פירא דכוורי (לקמן כתובות דף עט.), גומא:
Rashi on Ketubot 71b:2:2.english: A hole [pir] - Like [the expression] "a fish-pit" [pira dechavrei] (below, Ketubot 79a), [meaning] a pit.

Rashi on Ketubot 71b:3:1.hebrew: אלא הכא במאי עסקינן דתלינהו לקישוטיה בתשמיש - ומשום הכי מצי מיפר, דדלמא מתקשטת ומיתסרא הנאת תשמישו עליה:
Rashi on Ketubot 71b:3:1.english: Rather, with what are we dealing here? [With a case] where she made her adornment contingent upon intercourse - And therefore he can nullify [her vow], lest she adorn herself and the pleasure of intercourse with him become forbidden to her.

Rashi on Ketubot 71b:4:1.hebrew: כופה ומשמשתו - שאינה יכולה לאסור עצמה עליו, אבל יכולה לאוסרו עליה — שתהא היא מודרת ולא הוא — כגון הנאת תשמישו עליה, דצריך הוא להפר, שלא יאכילנה דבר האסור לה:
Rashi on Ketubot 71b:4:1.english: He compels her and she has intercourse with him - For she cannot forbid herself to him, but she can forbid him to her — so that she is the one bound by the vow and not he — such as [forbidding] the pleasure of intercourse with him to herself, in which case he must nullify [the vow] so that he does not feed her something that is forbidden to her.

Rashi on Ketubot 71b:5:1.hebrew: ולא תתקשט ולא תאסר - לר' יוסי, כיון דאמר אין אלו נדרי עינוי נפש, היאך יכול להפר? ואי משום דתלינהו בתשמיש, לא תתקשט ולא תיאסר:
Rashi on Ketubot 71b:5:1.english: And let her not adorn herself and she will not be forbidden - According to Rabbi Yosei, since he said these are not vows of self-affliction, how can [the husband] nullify [them]? And if [it is] because she made them dependent on marital relations, let her not adorn herself and she will not be forbidden.

Rashi on Ketubot 71b:5:2.hebrew: א"כ קרו לה מנוולת - וכי מבזו, מקשטא, אישתכח דנדר זה אוסרה עליו. לפיכך, יכול להפר משום דברים שבינו לבינה:
Rashi on Ketubot 71b:5:2.english: If so, they [will] call her repulsive - And when they demean [her], she adorns herself, [and] it turns out that this vow forbids her to him. Therefore, he can nullify [it] on account of matters between him and her.

Rashi on Ketubot 71b:6:1.hebrew: ותתקשט ותאסר אי לבית שמאי - אמאי יוציא לאלתר ויתן כתובה? ותתקשט ותאסר, והות ליה כמדיר את אשתו מתשמיש המטה, ותנן בפרק אף על פי: לבית שמאי שתי שבתות, ולבית הלל שבת אחת:
Rashi on Ketubot 71b:6:1.english: And let her adorn herself and be prohibited, if according to Beit Shammai - Why must he divorce [her] immediately and pay [her] ketubah? Let her adorn herself and be prohibited [from marital relations], and she is like [the wife of] one who prohibits his wife by a vow from marital relations; and we learned in the chapter [entitled] Af Al Pi: According to Beit Shammai, two weeks; and according to Beit Hillel, one week.

Rashi on Ketubot 71b:6:2.hebrew: הני מילי - שיש לו זמן שמא ימצא פתח לנדרו, היכא דאדרה איהו:
Rashi on Ketubot 71b:6:2.english: This applies - that he has time [given to him], [so that] perhaps he will find an opening [to annul] his vow, [only] where he took the vow against her.

Rashi on Ketubot 71b:6:3.hebrew: אבל היכא דנדרה איהי ואישתיק - ולא היפר, אינה יכולה לגור אצלו כלל, ואפי' עד שתאסר ע"י קישוט, דסברה מיסנא סני לי:
Rashi on Ketubot 71b:6:3.english: But where she vowed and he was silent - And did not nullify [the vow], she cannot live with him at all, even until she becomes prohibited through adornment, for she thinks: He hates me.

Rashi on Ketubot 71b:7:1.hebrew: וכמה קצבה - כלומר, אם נתן קצבה, עד כמה לא כייפינן ליה להוציא:
Rashi on Ketubot 71b:7:1.english: And how long is [the] set amount of time - That is to say, if he established a set amount of time, up to how long do we not compel him to divorce [her]?

Rashi on Ketubot 71b:8:1.english: Enjoys the scent of her adornments - That she adorned herself [with] before the vow.

Rashi on Ketubot 71b:9:1.english: When they are in a different city - [It is] the custom of their daughter to go to them on the Festivals.

Rashi on Ketubot 71b:9:2.hebrew: רגל אחד - מציא מוקמא אנפשה, שלשה לא מציא מוקמא. ובגמרא פריך: הא שנים מאי:
Rashi on Ketubot 71b:9:2.english: One pilgrim Festival - She is able to restrain herself; [for] three, she is not able to restrain [herself]. And in the Gemara it asks: What about two?

Tosafot on Ketubot 71b:13:1.hebrew: כאן ברדופה כאן בשאינה רדופה - פירש ר"ח: דרגל ראשון היא רגילה לילך ולהגיד שבחה בבית אביה, ורגל שני אינה רדופה כל כך, אף ע"פ שעדיין לא הגידה שבחה. ומתני' דקתני "רגל אחד יקיים" — היינו ברדופה ברגל ראשון, שלא הלכה עדיין בשום פעם אחר להגיד שבחה; והא דקתני "שנים יקיים" — בשאינה רדופה, כלומר ברגל שני או שלישי של חופה, שאינה רדופה אע"פ שעדיין לא הגידה שבחה, הואיל ואיחרה מללכת רגל ראשון. ואתי שפיר הא דגרסינן בכל הספרים "דכתיב", וגרסינן נמי "ואמר רבי יוחנן"; ולפירוש הקונטרס לא גריס "דכתיב", ולא גריס נמי "ואמר רבי יוחנן", אלא "אמר רבי יוחנן". רבינו תם:
Tosafot on Ketubot 71b:13:1.english: "Here [it refers] to [a woman who is] eager, [and] there to [a woman] who is not eager" - Rabbeinu Chananel explained that [on] the first Festival [after marriage] she is accustomed to go and tell her praise in her father's house, whereas [on] the second Festival she is not as eager [to go], even though she has not yet told her praise. And [thus] the Mishnah that teaches "for one Festival he may maintain [her]" — that is [referring] to [one who is] eager on the first Festival, since she has not yet gone at any other time to tell her praise; and that which it teaches "for two [Festivals] he may maintain [her]" — [that refers] to [one who is] not eager, that is to say, on the second or third Festival after the wedding, when she is not eager even though she has not yet told her praise, since she already delayed going on the first Festival. And [according to this] it fits well that we read in all the texts "as it is written," and we also read "and Rabbi Yochanan said"; whereas according to the explanation of the Kuntres [Rashi], he does not read "as it is written," and he also does not read "and Rabbi Yochanan said," but rather "Rabbi Yochanan said." Rabbeinu Tam.

Tosafot on Ketubot 71b:3:1.hebrew: כגון דתלינהו לקישוטיה בתשמיש המטה - ואם תאמר: ואמאי לא מוקי לה דתלינהו באיסור פירות שבעולם, ולא יוכל להקשות "ותתקשט ותאסר, אי לבית שמאי כו'"? ונראה לרשב"א: משום דאכתי הוה קשה ליה "דתתקשט ותיאסר לר' יהודה יום א'":
Tosafot on Ketubot 71b:3:1.english: "Where she made her adornment contingent upon sexual intercourse" - And if you ask: Why does [the Gemara] not establish it [as a case] where she made them contingent upon a prohibition of all produce in the world, so that one could not object: "Let her adorn herself and become forbidden! If according to Beit Shammai, etc."? And it appears to Rashba [that the reason is] because it would still be difficult for him [i.e., one could still object]: "Let her adorn herself and become forbidden for one day according to Rabbi Yehudah."

Tosafot on Ketubot 71b:5:1.hebrew: ולא תתקשט ולא תיאסר - פירוש: והיכי מצי מיפר, אבל לא פריך אמאי יוציא ויתן כתובה הואיל ויכולה לסבול שלא תתקשט, דא"כ לרב נמי תיקשי:
Tosafot on Ketubot 71b:5:1.english: Let her not adorn herself and she will not be forbidden - Explanation: [The Gemara is asking,] how can he nullify [the vow]? But it is not asking why he must divorce [her] and pay [her] ketubah since she can endure not adorning herself, for if so, [this] would also be difficult for Rav.

Tosafot on Ketubot 71b:6:1.hebrew: ותתקשט ותיאסר אי לב"ש כו' - דבשלמא עד השתא דס"ד שיש עינוי בקישוט ולא תלנהו בתשמיש, יוציא לאלתר ויתן כתובה, שאין לה להמתין כלל ולמנוע מקישוט:
Tosafot on Ketubot 71b:6:1.english: "And let her adorn herself and be prohibited, if according to Beit Shammai, etc." - For it was understandable until now, when it was thought that adornment involves affliction and she did not make it dependent on marital relations, [that] he must divorce [her] immediately and pay [her] ketubah, for she does not have to wait at all and refrain from adornment.

Tosafot on Ketubot 71b:6:2.hebrew: אבל הכא דנדרה איהי כו' - וא"ת: וימתין שמא ימצא פתח להקמתו, דנשאלים על ההקם, כדאמרי' בשילהי נערה המאורסה (נדרי' דף עט.). ואומר ר"י: דאין נשאלין על ההקם אלא ביום שמעו, שאמר לה "קיים ליכי"; אבל אם עבר יום שמעו, שאינו יכול להפר מחמת שהחריש לה, אינו יכול לשאול עוד. ואפילו אם תמצא לומר שיכול לשאול, אתי שפיר: דודאי כשהדירה הוא, תמתין לבית הלל שבת אחת, שאין קשה לה להמתין, דסברה דהשתא מירתח רתח ולאחר מיכן יתפייס; אבל הכא, דסברא מיסנא סני ואינה סבורה שיתפייס עוד, לא תקנו חכמים שתמתין, הואיל וקשה לה:
Tosafot on Ketubot 71b:6:2.english: But here, where she vowed, etc. - And if you ask: Let him wait, [for] perhaps he will find grounds [to annul] his confirmation [of her vow], since one may request absolution from a confirmation, as we say at the end of [the chapter] Na'arah HaMe'orasah (Nedarim 79a)? And Ri says: One may request absolution from a confirmation only on the day he heard [it], when he said to her, "It is confirmed for you"; however, if the day he heard [it] has passed, so that he cannot nullify [it] because he remained silent toward her, he can no longer request absolution. And even if you say that he can request absolution, it still works out well: for certainly when he vowed against her, she will wait one week according to Beit Hillel, since it is not difficult for her to wait, as she thinks that right now he is angry and afterward he will be appeased; but here, where she thinks that he despises [her] and she does not expect that he will ever be appeased, the Sages did not enact that she should wait, since it is difficult for her.

Tosafot on Ketubot 71b:9:1.hebrew: גבי חדש <abbr title="לא גרסינן">ל"ג</abbr> שלשה, <abbr title="דאם כן">דא"כ</abbr> הוה דייק עלה בגמרא כדדייק גבי רגל:
Tosafot on Ketubot 71b:9:1.english: Regarding [the case of] a month, we do not read "three," for if [that were] so, the Gemara would have made an inference about it just as it makes an inference regarding [the case of] a festival.
